title: Signed counts advance by displacement
statement: Let $l$ be a natural number, let $d$ assign a sign in $\{-1,0,1\}$ to each of the $l$ coordinates, and let $n$ assign a natural-number count to each of the $2l$ counters. For every coordinate $i$, the signed value of the counts after advancing the selected counters is the original signed value plus $d(i)$.
replaced: For every displacement vector, movement counts, and coordinate $i$, the signed value of the advanced counts at $i$ equals the signed value of the original counts plus the displacement at $i$.
